title: Ice Cream Sprinkle iPhone Charger Case Set
description_text: Description: Turn your charger into a treat with our Ice Cream Sprinkle iPhone Charger Case Set. Designed with a playful pink ice cream look, complete with colorful sprinkle details and a bite-effect corner, this set adds sweetness to your daily charging routine. The durable silicone case protects your adapter from scratches and wear, while the matching cable cover and coiled wire protector keep your charging cable neat and long-lasting. Cute, fun, and practical—perfect for anyone who loves a dash of dessert-inspired style!

Description:
Turn your charger into a treat with our Ice Cream Sprinkle iPhone Charger Case Set. Designed with a playful pink ice cream look, complete with colorful sprinkle details and a bite-effect corner, this set adds sweetness to your daily charging routine. The durable silicone case protects your adapter from scratches and wear, while the matching cable cover and coiled wire protector keep your charging cable neat and long-lasting. Cute, fun, and practical—perfect for anyone who loves a dash of dessert-inspired style!
